## Biography

The Veils Region is a zone of deep-space exploration in the direction of the galactic core — a network of nebulae, dust clouds, and stellar nurseries that obscure long-range sensors and complicate navigation. The name is descriptive: layers of interference that hide what lies beyond, like curtains drawn across a window.

During Distant Worlds 3, the expedition passed through the Veils on its way toward the Umbra Sagittarii. Lya established an observation post here, struggling with equipment calibration in the region's unpredictable magnetic environment. It was in the Veils that Flight Lieutenant Moyers detected the anomalous carrier-scale mass — the first indication that something had gone wrong in permit-locked space. The Veils did not cause the anomaly. They simply concealed it until the fleet was close enough to hear the signal through the noise.
